overclaims: These figures make 4 to 5 times total spend look doubtful for Cursor and Replit.
They make 4 to 5x total spend look unlikely unless operating costs are very large.
Equivalently, losses or cash burn of roughly 3 to 5 times revenue.
checks.note: Gross margins alone do not establish whether total spending of 4–5 times revenue is unlikely. No operating-cost figures support that inference. Also, total expenses of 4–5 times revenue imply losses of 3–4 times revenue; cash burn is not automatically equivalent. The unresolved outcome and citation metadata match the frozen case.
